boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten verified no-cost ways to gather on or near Butler’s campus, including public gardens, arts, astronomy, athletics, gaming, fitness, and bikeshare.

cards.title: Walk the Native Garden Beds
cards.subtitle: A free public garden on Butler’s campus
cards.notes: Meet by the garden entrance, follow the paths around all 13 native beds, and leave time to pause near the pond and carillon.
cards.short_summary: A relaxed campus walk through restored native plantings and established garden landmarks.
cards.evidence_claim: Butler states that Holcomb Gardens has been free and open to the public since 1928 and serves as a gathering and botanical-learning space.
cards.access_notes: Free and open to the public; stay on established paths and check campus notices before visiting.

cards.title: Look Through the 38-Inch Telescope
cards.subtitle: Weather-dependent telescope viewing without planetarium admission
cards.notes: Check the public-tour schedule and forecast, then join the telescope portion only; expect 66 stairs unless ground-level viewing is arranged.
cards.short_summary: A no-admission look through Indiana’s largest telescope when weather permits.
cards.evidence_claim: Butler states that viewing through the Holcomb Observatory telescope is always free, weather permitting; planetarium shows charge admission.
cards.access_notes: Telescope viewing is free and weather dependent. The telescope room requires 66 stairs; contact the observatory ahead for ground-level viewing.

cards.entity_name: Indiana Pacers Bikeshare at Butler University
cards.title: Take a Butler Bikeshare Loop
cards.subtitle: Free rides for eligible Butler pass holders
cards.notes: Activate the Butler pass before meeting, choose a short trail-connected loop, and return every bike securely to an available station.
cards.short_summary: A pass-based group ride from one of Butler’s campus bikeshare stations.
cards.evidence_claim: Butler states that students, faculty, and staff with an active Butler email are eligible to ride Pacers Bikeshare free through the university pass.
cards.source_title: Indiana Pacers Bikeshare at Butler University
cards.access_notes: Requires an active Butler email, application, promo code, and BCycle app activation. Visitors without an eligible free pass must pay.

cards.title: Set Up a Multiplayer Game Session
cards.subtitle: LAN, console, and board games for current Butler students
cards.notes: Confirm open-play hours, bring your Butler ID, and pick one shared game before arrival so the group can start together.
cards.short_summary: A student-only gaming meetup using the Esports Park’s included equipment and collections.
cards.evidence_claim: Butler lists Esports Park membership as free for current Butler students and says membership includes unlimited LAN, console-cart, and board-game access during operating hours.
cards.access_notes: Free for current Butler students during operating hours; summer camps or other programming may close the facility. Community access is paid.

cards.title: Plan a Recreation-Center Workout
cards.subtitle: Equipment and recreation access through student membership
cards.notes: Agree on a low-pressure workout, meet inside the HRC, and choose equipment or an activity that works for everyone’s comfort level.
cards.short_summary: An active student hang using the recreation membership included for eligible Butler students.
cards.evidence_claim: Butler states that students receive a full Health and Recreation Complex membership with access to its equipment, programs, and services.
cards.access_notes: Limited to eligible Butler students with HRC access. Bring a Butler ID and verify current facility hours before meeting.

cards.title: Watch a Butler Baseball Game
cards.subtitle: A ticket-free varsity event open to everyone
cards.notes: Choose a home date from the athletics schedule, meet before first pitch, and bring weather-appropriate layers for an outdoor game.
cards.short_summary: A casual group outing to a Butler baseball game without an admission charge.
cards.evidence_claim: Butler identifies baseball among the athletic events that require no ticket and are free to everyone, including the general public.
cards.access_notes: Free to students and the general public without a ticket. Verify the current home schedule and weather before attending.

cards.title: Catch a Butler Softball Game
cards.subtitle: No-ticket athletics for students and the public
cards.notes: Pick a home matchup, meet near the spectator entrance, and check for weather-driven schedule changes before leaving campus.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor spectator hang centered on a free Butler softball matchup.
cards.evidence_claim: Butler identifies softball among the athletic events that require no ticket and are free to everyone, including the general public.
cards.access_notes: Free to students and the general public without a ticket. Confirm the home schedule because outdoor games may change with weather.

cards.title: Cheer at a Butler Swim Meet
cards.subtitle: A no-ticket collegiate meet open to the public
cards.notes: Check the meet venue and start time, arrive before the first event, and use posted spectator areas throughout the competition.
cards.short_summary: An indoor athletics meetup with multiple races to watch together.
cards.evidence_claim: Butler identifies swimming among the athletic events that require no ticket and are free to everyone, including the general public.
cards.access_notes: Free to students and the general public without a ticket. Verify the current meet venue and spectator-access instructions.

cards.title: Follow a Butler Tennis Match
cards.subtitle: Free varsity competition with no ticket required
cards.notes: Select a home match, check whether play is indoors or outdoors, and settle near one court before the opening serve.
cards.short_summary: A flexible spectator outing where the group can follow several courts of play.
cards.evidence_claim: Butler identifies tennis among the athletic events that require no ticket and are free to everyone, including the general public.
cards.access_notes: Free to students and the general public without a ticket. Check the athletics schedule for the current venue and any weather relocation.

cards.title: Browse Six Rotating Galleries
cards.subtitle: A free indoor art outing north of Butler
cards.notes: Meet in the Michael Graves-designed building, browse the rotating galleries together, and finish with quiet work time in the library.
cards.short_summary: A no-admission gallery visit with indoor space for conversation, viewing, and study.
cards.evidence_claim: The Indianapolis Art Center states that its campus is always free, invites visitors to explore its galleries and Ruth Lilly Library, and charges no admission.
cards.access_notes: The indoor campus and galleries are free and open seven days a week. ARTSPARK is separately closed for renovation until Fall 2026.
